# Project Rules

- Read the relevant project documentation before changing code.
- Follow the existing architecture, API contracts, database schema, scoring formula, skill-gap categories, and 10-career taxonomy.
- Do not change the LLM provider, model, scoring weights, schema, or canonical taxonomy without explicit approval.
- Never expose API keys, CV contents, or personal data in logs, artifacts, or commits.
- Do not claim tests passed unless they were actually run.
- Do not implement Step 16–20 until the user manually validates the main pipeline and approves.
- Keep responses and changes focused; avoid unnecessary file reads and repeated tests.
